FX-TRITONE-001.says: The settings as they start: shadows #000000, midtones #8c7355, a sepia brown, highlights #ffffff, blend 0. A sepia print of the drawing by its lightness; black stays black and white white; the yellow at half covering takes the same colour as the yellow, at its own covering.

FX-TRITONE-002.says: Blend With Original 100: the drawing exactly as it is.

FX-TRITONE-003.says: Blend With Original 50: every pixel halfway, in linear light, between the drawing and FX-TRITONE-001.

FX-TRITONE-004.says: Shadows #1a2a6c, a navy, midtones #c0392b, a red, highlights #fdf3a7, a pale yellow: a night-to-sunset colouring; black turns exactly the navy and white the pale yellow.

FX-TRITONE-005.says: All three #6450a0: every pixel that shows is #6450a0 at its own covering, whatever its lightness.

FX-TRITONE-006.says: FX-TRITONE-004 with its colours written in capitals: the same.

FX-TRITONE-007.says: FX-TRITONE-004 at blend 70: each pixel 30 per cent of the way, in linear light, toward its colour.

FX-TRITONE-008.says: Blend keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is FX-TRITONE-003, frame 4 is FX-TRITONE-001.

FX-TRITONE-009.says: FX-TRITONE-004 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-TRITONE-010.says: Blend With Original 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TRITONE-011.says: Blend With Original -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TRITONE-012.says: Blend With Original keyed to 150 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TRITONE-013.says: Highlights written "#12345", one digit short. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TRITONE-014.says: Midtones written "brown", a name, not #rrggbb. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-TRITONE-015.says: Shadows written "#00000g", not a hex digit. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
